metadata.cpu: AMD Ryzen 9 PRO 7940HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics
metadata.method: Two fresh-worker rounds per fixture and phase, with reversed variant order in the second round. Parse and full HTML measured separately at the largest existing fixture per family. 500ms warmup, seven batches of at least 100ms with GC before each; separate 500ms CPU profile and 50-call heap sample at 4096 bytes, including collected objects. Position variants preserve the same reader tree after removing positions. Shared host; samples are not performance thresholds.
